promotion_checklist: Add a runnable example invocation to the skill entry point.
Add or keep a repository-level smoke or regression test.
Promote only after sandbox verification remains green.
recommended_next_steps: Harmonize variants and headers with GWASLab before exporting to LDSC, FUMA, or GWAS-SSF.
Resolve failed rows before LDSC, meta-analysis refreshes, or PRS derivation.
Clump retained lead variants with PLINK 2.0 before reporting independent loci.
Interpret the retained genome-wide significant loci with FUMA or a comparable locus-to-gene layer.
If you need an exchange or submission format, export the cleaned results toward the GWAS Catalog summary-statistics standard.

starter_steps: Normalize common summary-statistics headers into one local schema.
Flag malformed, duplicate, low-information, and ambiguous variants before downstream analysis.
Emit a flagged TSV and JSON summary with lead signals and interpretation recommendations.
Route cleaned outputs toward PLINK2, LDSC, FUMA, and GWAS-SSF compatible follow-up.
